title: Import from your bank
undoBody_one: The transaction added by this import will be removed. Anything you added yourself stays.
undoBody_other: The {{count}} transactions added by this import will be removed. Anything you added yourself stays.

errors.tooLarge: This file is too big. Imports are limited to 5 MB.
errors.tooManyRows: This file has more than 5,000 rows. Split it and import it in parts.
errors.noRows: We couldn't find any rows in this file.

source.currencyNote: Amounts are read as {{currency}}, the currency of this account.
source.noAccountsBody: Imported transactions are added to one of your accounts.
source.pasteHelp: Copy the rows from your spreadsheet, including the header row, and paste them here.
source.helpTitle: How to get your bank's file
source.helpBody: In your online banking, open the account, look for Export or Download and choose CSV (a spreadsheet file works too). You can also copy rows from a spreadsheet and paste them here.
source.privacy: The file is read on this device only. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no connection to your bank.

columns.ambiguousBody: These formats all fit the dates in your file: {{formats}}. Pick the one your bank uses.
columns.ambiguousPick: Choose the date format to continue.
columns.invertHelp: Turn this on if your bank shows expenses as positive numbers.
columns.remember: Remember this layout for this account
columns.savedLayout: Using the layout you saved for this account.
columns.errorsHelp: Check the columns, the date format and the decimal mark. Rows that still fail are left out.

review.flags: {{errors}} with errors · {{duplicates}} likely duplicates · {{skipped}} skipped (empty or zero)
review.ruleBody: Future imports will put every transaction containing "{{keyword}}" in {{category}}.

error.precision: Too many decimals for this currency

review.duplicateExisting: Looks like a transaction you already have

done.body: They are now part of your accounts and reports.
